WITH gas_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        t.Date,
        t.Amount
    FROM transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
),
annual_gas_use AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', Date) AS year,
        SUM(Amount) AS total_gas_use_eur
    FROM gas_transactions
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Date)
)
SELECT 
    year,
    total_gas_use_eur
FROM annual_gas_use
WHERE total_gas_use_eur = (SELECT MAX(total_gas_use_eur) FROM annual_gas_use);

WITH diallo_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(pa.ball_control) AS avg_ball_control
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'
),
appindangoye_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(pa.ball_control) AS avg_ball_control
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye'
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(d.avg_ball_control, 0) - COALESCE(a.avg_ball_control, 0) AS difference_of_average_ball_control
FROM diallo_stats d
CROSS JOIN appindangoye_stats a;

WITH kam_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Currency
    FROM customers
    WHERE Segment = 'KAM'
),
kam_total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_kam
    FROM kam_customers
),
kam_euro AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS kam_euro_count
    FROM kam_customers
    WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_kam > 0 
        THEN ROUND((CAST(kam_euro_count AS REAL) / total_kam) * 100.0, 2)
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS percentage_kam_euro
FROM kam_total, kam_euro;

comparison.actual_sql:
WITH member_event_expenses AS (
    SELECT 
        m.member_id,
        m.first_name,
        m.last_name,
        b.link_to_event,
        b.spent
    FROM member m
    JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN budget b ON a.link_to_event = b.link_to_event
    WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.spent > 0
),
members_with_multiple_events AS (
    SELECT 
        member_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_event) as event_count,
        SUM(spent) as total_spent
    FROM member_event_expenses
    GROUP BY member_id, first_name, last_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_event) > 1
)
SELECT 
    member_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    total_spent
FROM members_with_multiple_events
WHERE total_spent = (SELECT MAX(total_spent) FROM members_with_multiple_events)
ORDER BY total_spent DESC, first_name, last_name;
comparison.gold_sql: SELECT T2.member_id FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T1.link_to_budget = T3.budget_id INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3.link_to_event = T4.event_id GROUP BY T2.member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T4.event_id) > 1 ORDER BY SUM(T1.cost) DESC LIMIT 1
